verdict.rationale: Weave documents a REST Service API for programmatic access to Weave functionality. Its SDKs also cover tracing, evaluations, scorers, custom costs and OTel ingestion, and an MCP server lets agents read traces and run evaluations. However, nothing in the evidence claims or shows full API–UI parity, and UI features such as the Playground (saved models, model comparison) and leaderboards have no documented API equivalent. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of Playground, leaderboard, signal and alert configuration, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (the probes found none at the candidate docs paths), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use the Weave Service API, which provides REST endpoints for programmatic access to Weave functionality.
Add a custom cost with the `add_cost` method.
They can read live production data, run evaluations, and execute automatic iteration loops on their own
